sanskrit:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम् ॥ ९-१६॥
iast:
ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhāhamahamauṣadham
mantro’hamahamevājyam ahamagnirahaṃ hutam 9-16
translation: I am the KRATU; I am the sacrifice; I am the offering (food) to PITRIS (or ancestors) ; I am the medicinal herb, and all plants; I am the MANTRA I am also the clarified butter; I am the fire; I am the oblation.
